title: Evidence triage + audit touchpoints (scratch)
content:
Purpose / context:
- Quick scratch to prepare for Thursday's audit sync with external assessor + SRE backup. Keep informal notes here, will formalize after the call.
- Goal: confirm evidence owners, where artifacts live, and list any temporary compensating controls we need to document.

Attendees to invite (confirm):
- External: Assessor (Ben from KPMG)
- Internal: Elena (security), Maya (SRE/observability), Jordan (infra infra-ops), Priya (product ops - rollouts), Legal (optional if vendor questions escalate)

High-level agenda (30-40 min):
1) 5m - Objectives + timeline for evidence submission (assessor clarifies what they need next)
2) 10m - SOC2 CC mapping walkthrough (focus on: change mgmt, logical access, incident response evidence)
3) 10m - ISO 27001 overlap and cert scoping questions (what overlaps reduce duplication)
4) 5-10m - Vendor risk items + outstanding attestations from infra vendors
5) Rapid triage: agree owners and delivery ETA for each bucket

Notes / opening script (what I want to say):
- "We want to minimize bombardment with raw logs — prefer packaged artifacts (summaries + pointers to raw)."
- "Primary constraint is timebox for evidence upload; where possible we'll upload to the evidence bucket and link it in Confluence."

Evidence buckets to confirm (where artifacts live):
- Evidence drive folder: shared_drives/security/evidence/2024-soc2 (confirm access)
- Infra logs (raw): s3://redwood-logs/soc2-collection/YYYY/ (Maya)
- Change history: git provider (GH) PR audit trail + Jenkins pipeline run IDs -> Confluence links
- Access lists: Okta export (CSV) monthly snapshot stored in evidence drive

SOC2-specific asks I expect (pre-check):
- Logical access: Okta CSV for 2024-01-01 to present (owner: Jordan) -> SEC-301
- User provisioning/deprovisioning: ticket trail for last 6 months showing offboarding (owner: Priya)
- Change control: PR approvals + release notes for last 3 major releases -> (owner: Engineering leads)
- Incident response: 1 pager with timeline + postmortem link for any Sev1 in past 12 months (owner: SRE)
- Monitoring: SLO/SLA dashboards screenshots + retention config for alerts (owner: Maya)

ISO 27001 crosswalk points to raise:
- Scope statement: confirm which services/environments are in-scope for ISO (ask Product)
- Risk register: latest export (owner: Risk mgmt) - is it updated Q1?
- Statement of applicability: confirm where we have compensating controls documented

Vendor risk items (short list to surface):
- DB backups provider contract: confirm SOC2/ISO attestation on file (Legal -> contract path)
- Observability vendor (SaaS): log retention & data residency confirmation (Maya to confirm)
- Encryption key mgmt: KMS/HSM provider attestation + rotation logs (Infra)

Current gaps I need to call out (honest, short):
- Evidence location fragmentation (some artifacts still with teams not yet copied into the canonical evidence drive) -> risk: assessor misses context
- Old Okta exports missing metadata (need daily vs monthly snapshots)
- Incomplete PR linking practice to release notes for hotfixes -> breaks change mgmt trail

Quick remediation / compensating actions (if assessor asks):
- Provide consolidated evidence index (spreadsheet) that points to canonical artifact + raw link + short summary (owner: Elena) -> ETA: 2024-03-08
- Run an on-demand Okta export and attach to evidence folder (owner: Jordan) -> ETA: 2024-03-06
- Create a one-page "change mgmt cheat sheet" that shows how to find PR->release mapping (owner: Samir) -> ETA: 2024-03-07

Action items (explicit, single-line for handoff):
- Elena: build evidence index CSV and drop in shared_drives/security/evidence/2024-soc2/index.csv (due 2024-03-08)
- Jordan: produce Okta CSV (users + groups) for Jan 1 2024 -> now and scheduled weekly exports (due 2024-03-06)
- Maya: confirm SLO dashboard screenshots + retention policy; point to Grafana UID (due 2024-03-07)
- Priya: collate 6-month offboarding ticket examples (due 2024-03-07)
- Samir: short writeup for PR->release mapping and where to find pipeline logs (due 2024-03-07)
- Legal: pull vendor attestation docs for DB backups and KMS (notify if missing) (due 2024-03-10)

Questions to ask the assessor if time permits:
- Will they accept a summary + raw bucket links, or do they require files uploaded to an assessor portal?
- For ISO overlap: do they want separate artifacts or is a mapped crosswalk OK?
- Any minimum retention expectations they are checking beyond our policy?

Follow-ups after the call (my plan):
- Immediately update the index CSV with any new asks from assessor and assign (timestamp entries)
- Create a short Confluence note: "Audit sync 2024-03-07 — action tracker" and add owners + due dates (link back to this scratch)
- Schedule a 20m internal triage on 2024-03-06 to walk through the first three action owners

Quick scratch log (for my memory):
- 2024-02-20: started pulling sample Okta export (incomplete, missing group metadata)
- 2024-02-27: SRE confirmed Grafana retention policy is 90d for default metrics, 365d for alerts archive
- 2024-03-01: legal asked for vendor contact for backup provider; awaiting reply

Open uncertainties / decisions needed from leadership:
- Decide whether to scope non-prod logs out of evidence set (cost vs value tradeoff)
- Approve temporary extension for older offboarding ticket retrieval (if infra cost is high)

Random notes / shorthand (throwaway):
- If assessor asks for raw logs, propose a filtered sample with redacted PII.
- Consider tagging evidence with "packaged_for_assessor=true" in the index so we can filter easily.

Last-minute prep checklist (to do before call):
- [ ] index CSV stub in evidence folder (Elena)
- [ ] Okta CSV uploaded (Jordan)
- [ ] SLO screenshots linked (Maya)
- [ ] Offboarding samples added (Priya)
- [ ] Vendor doc list shared with Legal (Elena)

End of scratch — will convert to formal action tracker after the sync.
